svg.text: driver_xBigTreeTech TMC2209 V1.3 StepStick stepper driver
driver_yBigTreeTech TMC2209 V1.3 StepStick stepper driver
driver_zBigTreeTech TMC2209 V1.3 StepStick stepper driver
mains_inletIEC C14 panel inlet with fuse drawer and rocker switch
V24 24 V from PS1: load 3.6 A typical, 6 A peak; source 6.5 A cont, 7.1 A peak
3V3 3.3 V from A1: load 0.015 A typical, 0.06 A peak; source 0.5 A cont, 0.6 A peak
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_v24, splice_3v3) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
